description: Run /pan:quick on the two-plan seed (quick mode refuses a project with no roadmap): planner (quick mode) + executor produce a plan under .planning/quick/ and the requested source file, committed.
why: Reality check RC20/R17: quick mode (planner + executor, no research, checker or verifier) had no scenario. The observable outcome is a plan file in .planning/quick/<n>-<slug>/ and the artefact it asked for.

arms.why: The no-guidance baseline (M43, MI-114): the executor reduced to a one-line role. A paired run against the plain scenario shows whether PAN's executor guidance earns its tokens; a prompt change to the executor is measured against this arm as well as the baseline.
